svg.title: ACHILLES Skate Deck CNC V-Carve — Utah Tech Stinger III / Fusion 360
svg.desc: Units: inches. Import into Fusion 360 Manufacture or VCarve. Use V-Carve / Engrave toolpath with 60° or 90° V-bit. Designed for CAMaster Stinger III at Utah Tech Atwood Innovation Plaza Makerspace. Rider fit: 6ft4 / 190lb / US11 — deck ~8.5 x 32 in.
